entities.name: Betor
aliases: Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Abzan Houses
entities.description: The Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Abzan Houses on Tarkir, a collective of lost Abzan spirits who speaks as "we".

entities.name: Abzan Houses

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: Dragon who demanded the Abzan repudiate their honored dead.

events.summary: Narset performs the Stormnexus Ritual and Felothar calls Betor forth.
events.quote: They came into being after Narset performed the Stormnexus Ritual and Felothar called them forth.

events.summary: The lost and drifting Abzan spirits coalesce into Betor.
events.quote: the lost and drifting spirits of the Abzan coalesced into their being

events.summary: Dromoka demanded the Abzan repudiate their honored dead and branded ancestral worship unnatural.
events.quote: Dromoka had demanded the Abzan repudiate their honored dead
